name: Kiosk and app pinning
plain: Locks the phone to one app.
meaning: Used for kiosks and exams. Android has screen pinning for users and lock task for device owners; iOS has Guided Access and supervised Single App Mode.

android.permission: None (screen pinning); device owner for lock task
android.note: Lock task can disable status bar and nav.

ios.permission: MDM Single App Mode payload; ASAM (autonomous) via UIAccessibility.requestGuidedAccessSession
ios.prompt_ui: Guided Access triple click; ASAM needs supervision
ios.note: Exam apps use ASAM on supervised devices.

limits.headline: Can lock the phone to one app when you pin it or a company allows it
limits.user_action: You pin the screen, or triple click to start Guided Access
can: Keep you inside one app, like a kiosk or an exam
Hide the status bar and navigation (Android lock task, company set)
Run exam apps in single app mode on supervised iPhones
cannot: Lock the phone without your pin step or company control
Use lock task on Android unless the company is the device owner
Use autonomous single app mode on iPhone unless it is supervised
limits.differs: Android has screen pinning for you and lock task for device owners; iPhone has Guided Access and supervised Single App Mode.

story.what_it_is: Locks the phone to a single app, for kiosks, exams and kids.
story.for_you: A pin icon appears and the phone stays on one app. You cannot swipe away until you unlock with a gesture or a code. It feels like a locked room for that app.
story.for_makers: Schools, shops and tests need a phone that cannot wander. Pinning keeps the screen on the task and blocks notifications and the home screen. Fleet owners use a stronger lock mode on company devices.

use_cases.example: A student takes an online exam and cannot open other apps.
A store uses a tablet as a point of sale and it stays on the sales app.
A parent pins a phone to a learning game so a child cannot wander.
An airport kiosk keeps the check in app on screen all day.
A hospital tablet stays on a patient intake form.
A museum game kiosk is locked on the exhibit app.
A phone loan to a stranger is pinned to the phone dialer to make a call.

risks: Hard to exit if you forget the code
story.android_note: Android has screen pinning for users and lock task mode for device owners, which can also hide the status bar and navigation.
story.ios_note: iPhone has Guided Access for users and Single App Mode on supervised devices, used by exam apps.

technical_bounds: Third party apps cannot self pin on unmanaged devices on iOS
